card.name: Subject or verb before upcoming action
card.fires_on: No single word or setting; it fires on scattered words in general web prose, such as a subject noun, a modal, or a verb, just before a statement about what happens next.

modes.label: Scattered mixed words
modes.description: Nouns, verbs and adverbs in narrative or news text that precede an event or a plan.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are mixed across languages and the suppressed ones are time and appointment words, so it may lower the chance of a day or appointment word next.
card.plain: It has no clear trigger; it fires on assorted words in ordinary text and slightly discourages words about days or appointments.
